name: Lyngen warning-region pilot
purpose: Single-service Norwegian pilot using NVE RegObs observations and Varsom regional bulletins.
notes: This is a bounding envelope for the full Lyngen Varsom warning region. RegObs acquisition remains server-filtered to ForecastRegionName = Lyngen; the envelope is not itself a claim that every tile is inside the warning polygon. Reports are user-generated: preserve contributor attribution and require review before using a report as a positive label.
